name: vibe-no-aurora
setup: if (!window.MefiVibe.isActive()) await window.MefiVibe.enter(); const s = document.createElement("style"); s.textContent = ".vibe-aurora{display:none!important}"; document.head.append(s); return window.MefiVibe.isActive();

name: vibe-aurora-paused
setup: if (!window.MefiVibe.isActive()) await window.MefiVibe.enter(); const s = document.createElement("style"); s.textContent = ".vibe-aurora{animation-play-state:paused!important}"; document.head.append(s); return window.MefiVibe.isActive();

name: vibe-no-backdrop
setup: if (!window.MefiVibe.isActive()) await window.MefiVibe.enter(); const s = document.createElement("style"); s.textContent = "*,*::before,*::after{backdrop-filter:none!important}"; document.head.append(s); return window.MefiVibe.isActive();

name: vibe-anims-paused
setup: if (!window.MefiVibe.isActive()) await window.MefiVibe.enter(); const s = document.createElement("style"); s.textContent = "#vibe-layer *,#vibe-layer *::before,#vibe-layer *::after{animation-play-state:paused!important}"; document.head.append(s); return window.MefiVibe.isActive();

name: vibe-no-tree
setup: if (!window.MefiVibe.isActive()) await window.MefiVibe.enter(); window.MefiIdle.setHomeBackdrop(false); return true;
